blocks.text: Appliance Removal Services in Brampton, Ontario — Out of the Kitchen, Off Your Hands, Today

c: Brampton homes work their appliances hard. Many houses run two full kitchens, big households push washers through multiple loads a day, and when a machine finally quits, it tends to quit in the least convenient spot — wedged into a basement suite, boxed into a corner, or heavier than any two family members can safely move. One call solves it: our fully insured crew arrives, quotes free on the spot, disconnects the standard hookups, and carries the old unit out without a scratch on your home. blocks.text: From Bramalea's Original Streets to Mount Pleasant's Newest — Brampton Trusts Us With the Heavy Stuff

Live Junk Free has hauled appliances out of every kind of Brampton home: split-levels in Bramalea where the freezer's been running since the nineties, basement-suite kitchens in Springdale, brand-new builds in Mount Pleasant swapping builder units for upgrades, and everything across Castlemore, Heart Lake and downtown. items.title: Appliances are priced by truck space — not by weight

blocks.text: A dishwasher takes a small bite of the truck and costs accordingly; a kitchen's full set takes more. That's the entire formula. The fact that a fridge weighs as much as a piano changes nothing — weight, awkwardness and stairs are all absorbed into the flat volume rate.

items.title: We quote after seeing the unit and its exit path

blocks.text: The appliance is only half the job — the other half is the route: the basement turn, the narrow suite doorway, the backyard gate. Our quotes come after a free in-person look at both, which is why they hold. No phone guesses, no revised numbers later.

items.title: One figure covers pickup to processing

blocks.text: Disconnection of standard hookups, the dolly work, floor protection, hauling, recycling and disposal fees — all inside the single price you approve before we start. However stubborn the stairwell turns out to be, the number doesn't move.

items.title: Two-kitchen homes are our home turf

blocks.text: Thousands of Brampton houses run a second kitchen downstairs — which means twice the appliances reaching end-of-life. We clear basement-suite units through side entrances and narrow stairs routinely, single machines or full double-kitchen swap-outs, without disturbing tenants or family living below.

items.title: The quote is free and the choice is yours

blocks.text: No deposit, no commitment, no expiry. Approve the number and the appliance is on our dolly within minutes; decline and we leave with a handshake. Either way, the visit costs you nothing.

Frequently Asked Questions About Appliance Removal in Brampton, ON

items.q: Q: What does it cost to remove an appliance in Brampton?
a: A: Truck space sets the price — small loads start at $125, and a single fridge or washer sits at the low end of the scale. Weight and stairs never add a cent, and the flat figure quoted free at your door is exactly what you’ll pay.

items.q: Q: Can you take an appliance out of a basement apartment?
a: A: Every week — basement-suite kitchens are everywhere in Brampton and their appliances exit through the same narrow stairs and side doors they entered. Our crews handle the tight turns with dollies, straps and door-frame padding, and tenants barely notice we were there.

items.q: Q: Do I need to unhook anything before you come?
a: A: Leave plug-in units and standard water hookups to us — washers, dishwashers and fridge water lines get disconnected on the spot. The one rule: gas stoves and hardwired equipment must be disconnected by a licensed technician before removal. Mention the appliance type when booking and we’ll confirm what applies.

items.q: Q: The fridge still works — we just upgraded. Does it have to be scrapped?
a: A: Hopefully not. Working appliances are offered to our donation partners first, and a functional fridge or washer usually finds a second home. Recycling is the backup plan, not the default.

items.q: Q: Can you take both kitchens' worth of appliances at once?
a: A: Yes — and it’s cheaper together. A double-kitchen clear rides as one combined load priced by total volume, which always beats booking two separate pickups. Add any other junk to the same truck while it’s there.
